title: DID Management — Account Invite List — payload
description: An administrator of a DID hosting service lists the account invites on the domains they administer, without their secrets. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

domain.description: Only invites for this domain. Absent: every domain the issuer administers.

state.description: Only invites in this state. Absent: every state.

cursor.description: Opaque position from a previous response's `nextCursor`. Absent: the first page.

limit.description: The most invites to return. Absent: the consumer's default, at most 100.

referralVia.description: Only invites whose referral names this DID as `via`. Absent: any.

Response.title: DID Management — Account Invite List — response payload
Response.description: One page of invites, newest first. Failures use trust-task-error, not this shape.

invites.description: The page's invites, newest first. Empty when none match.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page. Absent on the last page.
